ai_summary: Here is the executive summary:  360 ONE WAM Limited reported a decline in Q2 FY27 Profit After Tax by 8.4% QoQ and 4.4% YoY, partly due to negative 'Other Income,' despite robust Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) AUM growth of 24.3% YoY and a declared interim dividend of Rs 7.50 per share. A material red flag is the auditor's 'Emphasis of matter' regarding an ongoing income tax demand and assessment stemming from a search operation, introducing financial uncertainty.
